mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS id, account_name, password, username, role, gender, email, organization, department, status, updated_at, deleted_at, created_at FROM sd_user WHERE account_name = #{accountName}
SELECT user_id AS id, account_name, password, username, role, gender, email, organization, department, status, updated_at, deleted_at, created_at FROM sd_user WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_user ( account_name, password, username, role, gender, email, organization, department, status ) VALUES ( #{accountName}, #{password}, #{username}, CAST(#{role} AS sd_user_role), #{gender}, #{email}, #{organization}, #{department}, CAST(#{status} AS sd_user_status) )
